sloka: तेन मुष्टिप्रहारेण सञ्चुकोप महाकपिः।कुपितश्च निजग्राह किरीटे राक्षसर्षभम् ।। ६.७०.४६ ।।
transliteration: tena muṣṭiprahāreṇa sañcukopa mahākapiḥ।kupitaśca nijagrāha kirīṭe rākṣasarṣabham ।। 6.70.46 ।।

translations.english: The great monkey hit by the fist (of Trisira) became furious and in anger he got hold of Trisira's head with crown.
